extracted.name: Honey oats Leopard Bread
extracted.description: #heirloom Believe me, the aroma of this tender crumb, pleasant flavor, healthy and yummy Honey oats bread from my kitchen is really amazing! I learned baking on my own by watching videos, from different groups. It's my own baked bread in a first go.
instruction_lines: In a bowl take warm water 3 tbsp, add sugar and yeast and let it get proofed for 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl take rolled oats,flour, yeast, honey & salt and incorporate well.
Mix lukewarm milk and oil together and add it to the flour mix.
Start kneading dough and make soft dough either by electric mixer. I have done with hands by kneading for 40-50 turns.
Make 3 parts of dough, Cover the bigger part and let it rest for 15 minutes..
For other 2 parts add different colors, give a gentle knead so that dough get colored.
Start shaping the dough into a loaf and place in a greased loaf pan.
Cover and let rise in a warm spot for an hour. It will get almost doubled. Preheat oven to 375° F & bake for about 25-30 minutes.
Tip:: After the first 15 minutes, cover the top of the loaf with a foil tent to prevent over-browning. Check it after 30 minutes by pricking tooth pick into it.
